verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents precise per-model context windows and output caps (e.g. "1M token context window by default, 128k max output tokens"), maintains a dedicated context-windows guide and models overview table, and exposes a programmatic /v1/models endpoint returning max_input_tokens, max_tokens, and a capabilities object plus a token-counting endpoint — this is exact, non-marketing specification rather than vague ranges. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that documented limits match real API behavior across all models, and no single consolidated table cross-referencing all models' input/output limits in one evidence item.
